title: LLM table structure hypothesis v1
description: Output contract of the (future) llm_table_understanding proposer track. The geometry validator (table_geometry_validator.py) is the sole signing authority: an unsigned or rejected hypothesis has no downstream effect. Hard constraints encoded by this schema: (1) no free-text/prose fields exist anywhere — the proposer may only emit structured coordinates, role labels, header-level counts and confidence grades, so the format itself closes the hallucination injection channel; (2) every coordinate is a [row, column] pair that MUST reference a value already present in the input physical matrix (the validator enforces in-bounds + canonical-anchor membership). The role enum is identical to STRUCTURAL_ROLES in table_structure.py and to the existing review-panel schemas (table_cell_item.schema.json structural_role, table_cell_dispositions_v2.schema.json role), so disposition write-back stays isomorphic with auto-signed hypotheses. Per AGENTS.md 'code wins', the five-role panel enum is authoritative over the six-item conceptual list in the implementation plan.

table_structure_version.description: Physical table-structure version that produced the input matrix (e.g. table-structure-v8). Metadata reference only; not free text.

header_level_count.description: Number of header levels the proposer asserts for this table. 0 means headerless.

cells.description: Per-cell role annotations. Coordinates reference existing matrix values only.

role.description: Aligned verbatim with STRUCTURAL_ROLES / review-panel role enum.

confidence.description: Per-cell proposer confidence; aligned with table_cell_dispositions_v2 confidence grades.

semantic_merges.description: Declarations that a set of existing matrix cells should be treated as one logical unit downstream. The geometry validator verifies each group does not cross a vMerge physical boundary and that concatenating member cell text does not drift protected encodings.

coordinates.description: Member coordinates of one semantic-merge group. minItems 2: a single cell needs no merge declaration.
